text:
ashley: quick pass — dropped a Figma patch for the console dark theme. main asks: chart series visibility, inline code/syntax legibility, and the theme-toggle copy. link: https://figma.com/file/xyz (preview slides 3–6). please skim.

kevin: looks nice overall. cards feel solid but the line charts on the metrics page lose detail — the light blue series (#5cc3ff) on the bg (#0b1220) reads faint at smaller widths. at 400px it's almost invisible. :thinking_face:

olga: agree with kev. can we try swapping the lighter blue for a slightly warmer tone and add contrast to the grid? e.g., series: #3fb0ff -> #2aa6ff; grid: rgba(255,255,255,0.04) instead of full 0.06. that keeps depth but improves separation.

jun: tiny copy nit — the toggle currently says "Dark" / "Light" only. i vote for "Theme: System / Light / Dark" (explicit) so users know there's a system default. new users get confused when it flips on system changes.

ashley: i like that. @design-bot can you update the i18n keys? prefer label: "Theme preference — System, Light, Dark" so translators have context.

design-bot: auto-update: i18n key theme.preference_label -> "Theme preference" (context: chooses UI theme: System/Light/Dark). updated in branch feat/theme-i18n.

kevin: accessibility: inline code blocks currently use token-bg: #0f1722 and token-text: #9aa7b3. that's ~3.0 contrast. need >=4.5 for WCAG AA small text. two options: lighten text to #cfe7ff or darken bg to #081016. leaning to lighter text to preserve background depth.

olga: +1 for preserving depth. sample CSS proposals below — small change set that keeps the aesthetic but raises contrast:

```
--bg-surface: #0b1220;            /* unchanged */
--code-bg: #0f1722;               /* current */
--code-text: #cfe7ff;             /* proposed */
--chart-series-1: #2aa6ff;        /* stronger blue */
--chart-series-2: #8be39a;        /* green accent for success */
--chart-grid: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); /* subtle grid */
```

kevin: can we also tweak the syntax highlight palette? the current keyword color and string color are too close in luminance. suggest keywords -> #ffb86b, strings -> #9be7a9 so they separate more in hue and contrast.

jun: copy follow-up — the tooltip language on charts says "value" — can we make it "value (est.)" when the series is an estimate? small but reduces support questions.

ashley: good call. i'll open a tiny PR: change CSS tokens + toggle label + tooltip string. kev/olga can you both quick-review? i'll run axe and include a short checklist: color contrast, focus rings, and compressed viewport tests.

kevin: 👍 i'll run contrast checks and post results here.

olga: i'll update the figma swatches and push comments on the slide with before/after snapshots.

design-bot: reminder: deploy-preview created at: https://deploy.preview/redwood-console/feat/theme-i18n — live for testing (expires in 48h).
